DocMind AI — PDF Assistant

An AI-powered PDF question-answering application. Users can upload documents and ask questions about their content in natural language. The project combines a responsive chat interface, document upload, conversation history and a retrieval-augmented generation workflow.

E-commerce AI · 2026 02

STRZ AI — Shopping Assistant

An AI shopping-assistant workflow connected to Shopify product data, designed to help customers discover relevant products. Includes an AI model endpoint, product-search logic and concise, store-aware response instructions that avoid inventing products.
